g.text: Themes: the per-theme grade S = C x Q, where C is the share of the theme's 10 core jobs the tool does (of those whose status is known; at least 7 must be) and Q its mean speed x accuracy on the core jobs it was timed on against at

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #333333

g.text: least one other tool; dot size = S relative to the theme's best (best >= 0.9, good >= 0.6, moderate >= 0.3, low); hollow ring = does some core jobs but was not graded (not timed on a contested task, or too many unknowns); grey dot

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #333333

g.text: = does none of them. Scores: accuracy = agreement with each task's reference answer; scalability = 1 − log10(t / t_fastest)/3 at the largest size; stability = share of the perturbation tests (rows shuffled, chromosomes reordered,

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #333333

g.text: samples reordered) answered identically; usability = a ten-item checklist (packaged, docs, tutorial, API reference, tests, CI, active, peer-reviewed, open license, library API); overall = geometric mean, given only when accuracy

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #333333

g.text: was measured. Genomeblocks' usability lacks only the peer-reviewed item.

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: Not shown (in the inventory, not benchmarked here): 3D-GNOME, AGAT, AIList, Activity-by-Contact (ABC), ArchR, BART2, BCBio.GFF, Bedshift, BiocPy summarizedexperiment, Biopython GenomeDiagram, C3D, CHiCAGO, CREAM, Cicero, Circos, Cistrome-GO, ColoWeb,

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: Coloc-stats, CoverageView, DEBrowser, DEGseq, DESeq (legacy), Degust, DiffBind, EBSeq, FAN-C (fancplot), GAT, GENOVA, GEO2R, GREAT (web), GTFtools, GenomeKit, GenomeSpy, GenometriCorr, Genomic HyperBrowser, GenomicDistributions, Gosling / gos, HTSeq

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: GenomicArray, Hi-Cociety, HiC-DC+, HiC-Pro, HiC1Dmetrics, HiCExperiment / HiContacts, HiCExplorer (hicPlotMatrix / hicPlotTADs), HiCHub, HiCPlotter, HiCcompare, HiChIP-Peaks, HiCseg, Hub-enhancer / enhancer-community analyses (method only), IGD,

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: IntervalStats, Intervene, JASPAR web tools, JBrowse 2, Juicebox, LILY, LOLAweb, LocusZoom, Logomaker, MACRO-APE / PERFECTOS-APE, MAnorm2, MINE, MotifDb, NOISeq, OLOGRAM (pygtftk), OmicVerse, PAVIS, PWMEnrich, PWMScan, Peakachu, Pscan, QuIN, RELI,

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: RNAlysis, ROSE2, RSAT, RUVSeq, RcisTarget, RegRegSEA, SEanalysis 2.0, STAMP, SciPy (csgraph), Signac, SnapATAC2, SummarizedExperiment, Sushi, TF-COMB, TF-MoDISco-lite, TFBSTools, TFEA.ChIP, TOBIAS, UCSC Genome Browser, UniBind Enrichment, Vierstra

g.text: motif archetypes, WashU Epigenome Browser, Wilcoxon rank-sum DE (Li et al. 2022), apeglm, ashr, bamsignals, baySeq, bedr, bedtk, bigwig-loader, biobear, bioinfokit, bx-python, cgranges, chipenrich, chromosight, coitrees, conorm, coolpup.py, dcHiC,
